change_summary.scope_change: Zone coverage narrowed from [Z23, Z34, Z45] to [Z23] only, per explicit project-owner decision.
change_summary.metric_change: metric_version updated from 2.0.0 to 2.1.0 (additive drift-bounded fix). 2.0.0 remains computable unchanged for historical comparability; 2.1.0 is now the acceptance-relevant metric.
change_summary.threshold_change: Thresholds selected for the first time in this version, from four retained Z23 attempts (C16-continuity-007, C16-continuity-008, C17, C18) using metric_version 2.1.0.
change_summary.authorization_change: None. review_gate authorization fields are unchanged (still false) pending the independent Claude Stage 9B verdict (STAGE9_PASS/STAGE9_FAIL) and explicit owner approval of this draft.

remediation_evidence.defect_description: Sub-0.7 Hz baseline-drift power (55-94% of out-of-band denominator across all 8 real channel-windows) dominated the noise-power term, masking a genuine, cross-window-consistent cardiac peak (1.40-1.57 Hz, physiologically 84-94 bpm) behind a negative SNR reading.
remediation_evidence.regression_tests_passed: 4/4 (byte-identical v2.0.0 backward match, 1.4-1.6 Hz peak detection on real windows, synthetic drift-isolation boundary within 0.12 dB across driven drift, synthetic negative control with consistency_score 0.0)
remediation_evidence.harmonic_vs_cardiac_check: Cardiac-band bin does not continue the drift harmonic comb decay; it is a local upward step (5x-9x) above its nearest lower-harmonic neighbor in 6 of 8 traces, evidence against the cardiac peak being leaked drift harmonic energy.

thresholds.selection_basis: Margin below the weakest observed real Z23 value per channel: RED weakest observed 6.89 dB (margin 1.89 dB), IR weakest observed 3.67 dB (margin 1.17 dB), consistency weakest observed 0.909 (margin 0.059).

non_retained_attempts.cause: Storage/tooling failure (external plan, firmware evidence, CAL-NC reservation, raw notification journal, result, and manifest were stored under /private/tmp and purged by the OS between turns) -- not a physiological or hardware rejection. Reconstruction forbidden.

selection_sample.caveat: Small sample (n=4 retained of 5 authorized, single zone). Thresholds reflect current evidence only and carry no statistical margin beyond the stated per-channel gap; a future attempt below these values could still represent normal measurement variance rather than true failure. Independent review must assess whether this sample size is sufficient on its own terms.

thresholds.selection_constraint: Must not be selected from the seven retained Stage 9 v1 accepted windows.
thresholds.constraint_note: Selected from STAGE9B-VN001-EXPOSURE-001 batch attempts (v2 exposure characterization), not from the v1 accepted windows.

review_gate.pending_action: Run the dedicated STAGE9_RECOVERY_PLAN.md Stage 9B Claude independent-review prompt against this draft. Only a returned STAGE9_PASS verdict plus explicit owner approval may flip stage9b_completion_authorized and stage10_authorized to true, and that edit must be made by the owner or by whoever owns the contract file directly — not authorized by this draft alone.
